name: Queen mate
hint: Use the queen to shrink the king's box a knight's move away, then bring your king up. Watch for stalemate.

name: Rook mate
hint: Cut the king off with the rook, use your king to take the opposition, then check along the edge.

name: Two bishops mate
hint: Bishops side by side make a wall. Drive the king to a corner with king support.

name: Bishop and knight mate
hint: Mate only happens in a corner of the bishop's colour. Learn the W-manoeuvre with the knight.

name: King and pawn: key squares
hint: King on the sixth rank in front of its pawn always wins (except rook pawns). Keep the opposition.

name: King and pawn: hold the draw
hint: Stay in front of the pawn and take the opposition when the enemy king approaches.

name: Rule of the square
hint: Draw the square from the pawn to its promotion rank. Step into it and you catch the pawn.

name: Lucena position
hint: Check the king away first, then build a bridge: rook to the fourth rank to block the checks.

name: Philidor defence
hint: Keep your rook on the sixth rank until the pawn advances, then check from behind.

name: Wrong rook-pawn bishop
hint: The bishop cannot control the corner square. Get your king to h8 and stay there.
